newsitem.title: USA: Coventry Corp to sell medical practices.
newsitem.headline: Coventry Corp to sell medical practices.

text.p: Coventry Corp said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to sell the medical practices of HealthAmerica, its health plan in Pittsburgh, Pa., to Allegheny Health, Education and Research Foundation for an after-tax gain of $3 million.
In connection with the sale, Allegheny Health and HealthAmerica said they will also enter into a 10-year agreement for provision of health care services for a fixed percentage of premium.
Allegheny Health is a 2,650 bed academic health center located in Pennsylvania.
Coventry is a managed care helath company based in Nashville, Tenn.
Consummation of the transaction is subject to state and federal regulatory review, as well as by Coventry's bank lenders.
